spec.description:
Bradford Polymax Ceiling Insulation is a premium thermal and
acoustic polyester batt designed specifically for residential roof spaces and
ceilings. Made from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibres containing up to 80%
recycled content, it provides soft, itch-free handling without chemical binders
or added formaldehyde. It keeps homes cooler in summer and warmer in winter,
will not pack down or deteriorate, and is approved by the National Asthma
Council's Sensitive Choice program.

install:
Ensure roof space is safe, de-energise electrical circuits before
entering ceiling if required by state regulations

Friction-fit batts between
ceiling joists without gaps

Butt edges firmly together to create a continuous
thermal barrier

Maintain required safety clearances around non-IC rated
recessed downlights, exhaust fans, and flue pipes per AS 3999

Start from the
perimeter plates working inward toward the ceiling manhole

Do not compress
batts or cover electrical equipment not rated for insulation contact
selection_checklist:
Confirm ceiling joist spacing (430mm width for 450mm
centres, 580mm width for 600mm centres)

Confirm target R-value required by
NCC climate zone or 7-star NatHERS energy rating (e.g. R3.5, R4.0)

Check
ceiling cavity clearance and truss heel height

Verify non-combustible
requirement (polyester does not meet AS 1530.1)

Confirm downlight IC ratings
to determine clearance requirements
limitations:
Must not
cover non-IC rated downlights or high-heat appliances without proper
clearances
Avoid compressing batts which reduces thermal performance

retrieval.rag_summary:
Bradford Polymax Ceiling Insulation is a soft, non-irritant
ceiling batt manufactured from 100% thermally bonded polyester fibres with up
to 80% recycled PET. Offered in thermal ratings from R2.5 to R4.0 (140mm
to 220mm thickness), it friction-fits between standard ceiling joists to prevent
roof-space heat transfer and reduce outdoor noise intrusion. Free from
formaldehyde, chemical binders, and loose respirable fibres, it carries National
Asthma Council Sensitive Choice accreditation and is backed by
Bradford's 70-year performance warranty.
